title: sideritis spinulosa subsp. ilicifolia
intro: Sideritis spinulosa subsp. ilicifolia, commonly known as the Spanish ironwort or Greek ironwort, is a perennial plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis spinulosa subsp. ilicifolia include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit gastroprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal remedies.
